leah_m: quick follow-up from the loader RFC — proposing a manifest-driven prefetch quorum + soft-fallback shim for safetensors sharded models. want to lock interface and telemetry before RFC update.

sanjay_r: quorum? sounds heavy for PLG. can you summarize tradeoffs?

leah_m: short: each shard lists mirrors/variants in manifest. prefetch succeeds when quorum (MAJORITY / N-of-M) of replicas fetched and checksummed. if quorum fails within timeout -> either use a shim presenting same keys/shapes (dtype-converted) or route to cold-serving. goal: never expose half-mapped tensors.

tom_b: shim is ok only for limited kinds of tensors. running dequant on large attention matrices is expensive and may break perf. manifest needs `shim_allowed` tags like ["embedding","bias"] and `compat_level` enum {BINARY_COMPAT, SEMANTIC_CONVERTIBLE, NO_SHIM}. loader refuses shim unless SEMANTIC_CONVERTIBLE.

nina_s: telemetry: we need `hotstart.event` with `result` in [ok_quorum, shim_used, failed, timeout, corrupt], plus `requested_shards`, `fetched_replicas`, `shim_type`, `quorum_policy`. also `hotstart.quality_delta` for eval gating.

sanjay_r: fallback storms concern: propose per-model `hotstart_credits` token-bucket (keyed by model+region). infra-bot: can quota service provide this?

infra-bot: yes. we expose `hotstart-token-bucket` with default refill 1/min, burst 5. API available.

leah_m: checksum semantics: verify replica_checksum then assembled_checksum. failure at any step -> fallback. manifest sample: `{"shard_entry":{"path":"...","mirrors":["s3://a","s3://b"],"replica_checksum":"..","assembled_checksum":"..","compat_level":"SEMANTIC_CONVERTIBLE","shim_allowed":["embedding"]}}`

tom_b: swapping shim->assembled must be atomic. sequence: `prepare_swap() -> quiesce_inflight() -> commit_swap() -> kvcache.invalidate(keys)`. runtime must quiesce within T_swap.

nina_s: eval gating: require eval artifacts for pinned models; if shim_used and eval delta > threshold -> fail hotstart and escalate. for PLG, log only.

sanjay_r: tests: unit for quorum logic, integration with s3-mock for mirror failover, perf microbench for shim overhead. rollout: feature-flag `hotstart_quorum_v2` default MAJORITY in canaries, collect two weeks metrics then promote.

leah_m: action items: (1) update RFC with manifest schema + state machine + swap hooks; (2) sanjay integrate token-bucket; (3) tom add shim perf microbench; (4) nina add telemetry + permits gating.

infra-bot: CI: loader-quorum-tests: green (41s) :white_check_mark:

leah_m: thanks all. will post RFC revision here when ready. :rocket:
